maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is recurring payment processing fees on merchant volume, plus banking and payables; not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private merchants, ISOs, software vendors and businesses paying processing fees; not government-funded.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by adding merchants (about 3.7K new per month) and products; acquisitions are only occasional, not the main growth path.

mission_critical.reason: Payment processing, MX Merchant POS, banking and payables are embedded in operations; switching means re-boarding, integration work and downtime risk.
